GOAL: orient before writing the one idea; confirm progress tool exists and survey workspace for baseline mechanisms to avoid copying.
READ: search("append_progress") found namespace progress with tools.progress.append_progress. glob **/*.md in ideation_4 dir returned no files.

EVIDENCE: glob result empty; tool catalog shows progress namespace.
REASONING: I must rely on the round history given in the prompt (branch-geodesic-rank, fork-angle-transport, and the round_20261028_212003_968 list of BRANCHCURV-SID, GEO-SHELL-RQ, GEOPFX-SID, GEO_REPAIR, GYRO-TARGET-RQ, KAPPA_BRANCH, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ, SUCC-TAN-RQ, behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts) and pick a coupling position not covered: behaviour-weighted curved optimal transport / Sinkhorn assignment inside the RQ-VAE residual quantizer stack.
OPEN: write the single idea block and append it as final record.

FINAL RESULT (record capped at 4000 chars; full block printed in the reply).
IDEA: cocond-markov-poincare-ot -- successor-diffused assignment mass inside a Poincare-cost Sinkhorn quantizer for RQ-VAE SIDs.
What it is: at every RQ level, the residual is exp-mapped to the kappa=-1 Poincare ball; the code-assignment plan is a 3-sweep entropic OT plan with ground cost D_ij = 2*artanh(||(-p_i)(+)c_j||), whose rows are diffused by one Markov step along a training-only popularity-adjusted directed-transition matrix B_bt: P <- (1-alpha)P + alpha*(B_bt@P), then column-normalised to the measured usage prior q. Hard code j* = argmax P gives the SID token; the codebook is a closed-form Klein-space Einstein barycenter with weights P (detached), c_j = exp_0(sum_i P_ij*Klein(p_i)/sum_i P_ij). Decoder still sees Euclidean log_0(c), so the generative interface is unchanged.
Why it is distinct from earlier rounds: earlier work moved latents, ranks, angles, shells, cones, tangents, per-branch curvature and prefix losses. This moves the ASSIGNMENT PLAN and the CODEBOOK MEAN themselves; behaviour is a stochastic operator inside the OT iterate, geometry is the cost kernel plus the barycenter, and both act in one pathway (plan -> argmax -> SID token, and plan -> codebook update).
Derived constants (no sweeps): tau = median Poincare distance of the first batch; alpha = mean top-1 outgoing transition probability in the training split; q = usage EMA from uniform; T = 3 documented default; m = 20 successors per item sparsity default; kappa = -1 fixed.
Switches present, not trained: behaviour-off (alpha=0, uniform q, unweighted barycenter), geometry-off (squared Euclidean cost, identity maps, arithmetic mean), both-on (the single run).
Cost at frozen scale: ~9*B*K distances (B=1024,K=256,L=3) = 2.36M evals plus 3 sparse B@P per level, under 5% of a step (0.05-0.10 s/step), ~1-2 h extra over 72,000 steps on four cards, +3 MB/level.
Judgement: Stage3 test Recall@10 > 0.065 in one 3000-epoch run; observables are SID changes, successor-prefix hit rate, and H(code|previous item).
Open/uncertain: transition sparsity may make B_bt ~ I (mechanism collapses to plain curved Sinkhorn); Sinkhorn+STE desynchronisation and barycenter boundary drift are the main failure modes.
